Hem Chandra ……….Petitioner
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand 
and others …….Respondents
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Vinay Kumar, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. B.S. Koranga, learned B.H. for the 
State/respondent nos.1 and 2.
3. Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, learned counsel for 
respondent no.3.
4. It is contended by learned counsel for the 
petitioner that the petitioner appeared in a selection 
process for recruitment on the post of Workshop 
Instructor as S.C. Category candidate.
5. According to learned counsel for the petitioner, 
the respondent no.4 and 5 were selected under the 
General Category and the last man selected in the 
General Category is respondent no.5 with 47.25 
marks.
6. It is further contended by learned counsel for 
the petitioner that those candidates belonging to 
S.C. Category who scored more marks than the last 
man selected in the General Category were not 
migrated to the open category.
7. Respondent no.4-Mohd. Faizan Ansari scored 
54.00 marks. The S.C. Category candidate who 
scored more marks than the last man selected in the 
General Category are Ankit Kumar who scored 63 
marks and Shubham Kumar who scored 62.25  marks were not migrated to the open category which
resulted into deprivation of the petitioner being 
selected.
8. Issue notice to respondent nos.4 and 5 
returnable within four weeks.
9. Steps to be taken within three days.
10. List this case on 07.09.2026.
11. In the meantime, respondent(s) may file 
counter affidavit(s).
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 06.07.2026
SK
